 protein (yogurt, nut butter, powdered milk,

as desired. If you don’t have frozen fruit handy, you can add ice cubes to
the smoothie for that cool and frosty feeling. To spur your creativity, here
is a template for making smoothies, with many tried-and-true combina-
tions on the next page.

1/2 cup (115 g) low-fat (Greek) yogurt (plain or flavored) or milk

1 cup (240 ml) fruit juice

1/2 to 1 cup (80 to 160 g) fruit, fresh, frozen, or canned

Optional: 1/4 cup (30 g) milk powder; chia seeds, ground flax,
dry oatmeal, graham crackers, peanut butter, dash cinnamon
or nutmeg; sweetener as desired; whatever else suits your
fancy.

1. Place all ingredients in a blender.

2. Cover, and whip until smooth.

Yield: 1 serving
NUTRITION INFORMATION: 220 to 290 total calories; 50 to 60 g carbohydrate; 5 g protein;
0 to 39 fat
